assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one illustrated destination-card texture atlas for the Neon Fare arcade driving game.
Primary request: Generate a brand-new 1536 x 1024 landscape image, exactly SIX equal SQUARE illustrations arranged in a strict 3-column by 2-row grid. Each cell is exactly 512 x 512. Vertical boundaries at x=512 and x=1024, horizontal boundary at y=512. The six scenes meet edge-to-edge with absolutely zero gutters, zero margin, zero frames, zero decorative borders, zero rounded corners, and no text. Treat this as a precision game texture atlas, with all six complete compositions readable as tiny square cards.
World: a fictional peninsula called Palm Reach inspired by Miami around 1988 to the early 1990s. Original architecture, warm ivory and shell-pink stucco, seafoam and lilac Art Deco details, hot-pink and cyan neon accents, elegant royal palms, bright turquoise water. Consistent rich sunset-to-dusk palette across the atlas.
Style/medium: polished graphic illustration with painterly rendering, precise architectural shapes, gently printed travel-poster texture, strong silhouettes and richly readable foreground/midground/background, comparable to premium illustrated arcade destination cards. Detailed and inviting, with cinematic but uncluttered composition; not photorealistic, not pixel art, not a flat vector icon.
Exact scene ordering, left to right then next row:
TOP LEFT: Calle Luna cafe quarter. Intimate lively pastel street corner with striped cafe awning, an open record-shop storefront visually shown by vinyl record displays, a few bright market fruit stalls, distinctive warm neighborhood Art Deco facades and royal palms. Clear cafe-quarter focal point.
TOP CENTER: Ocean Ribbon. An iconic tall stepped and curved pastel Art Deco hotel with rounded corners, strong vertical geometric cyan/hot-pink neon fins with no lettering, overlooking a sweeping palm boulevard. The hotel is the unmistakable dominant focal point.
TOP RIGHT: Mirage Bay. Seen from the water, a long graceful causeway sweeping toward a compact original pastel-and-glass coastal skyline, turquoise bay reflecting rose-gold dusk, palms at the edges. The causeway and skyline are both clear.
BOTTOM LEFT: Moonwater Yacht Club. Elegant low ivory and seafoam streamlined waterfront clubhouse, polished marina with sleek late-1980s motorboats and several white yachts, turquoise water catching pink and cyan dusk reflections, royal palms. Large readable boat silhouettes.
BOTTOM CENTER: Sundial Lighthouse. A tall simple WHITE TAPERED lighthouse on a ROUND small sandy cape, encircled by turquoise/indigo sea at blue hour, warm lantern glow, a few royal palms and sea grass. The lighthouse and rounded cape dominate this square.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Mirage Marine Stadium. An original waterfront venue with a dramatic long FOLDED CONCRETE CANOPY of angled repeating triangular roof sections, a bright pink/cyan roller-skating court in the foreground, the bay behind, elegant palms and sunset glow. The folded roof and colorful court dominate.
Composition constraints: every scene entirely contained within its own exact square; each square has a distinct single destination focal point with enough safe space around it for a square crop. Six distinct compositions, no repeated landmarks. No images crossing panel boundaries.
Avoid: ALL words, lettering, typography, labels, numbers, logos, watermarks, named real-world buildings, actual city names, borders, gutters, swamp, cypress, Spanish moss, modern supercars, science-fiction towers, collage fragments. Neon is luminous geometric tubes only, never letters.
Output: one seamless 1536 x 1024 atlas containing exactly the six 512 x 512 square cells above.
